measurement_revision: Base revision plus the changed source files identified below.
fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted relative path + NUL + content SHA-256 + newline for every Rust source in bins/ and crates/.
scope: All 13 Cargo workspace members; default features; macOS arm64; Rust 1.98.1; cargo-llvm-cov 0.8.4; default filename filtering; no custom exclusions.
environment: SHERPA_ONNX_LIB_DIR points to cached sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 macOS arm64 static libraries.

browser_regression.behavior: Double-click word selection and held mouse-drag selection survive resize synchronization and copy via ControlOrMeta+C.

baseline.workspace_comparison: Not comparable: the older artifact covered 12 workspace members; the current workspace has 13 members and additional provider behavior.

review.new_behavior: All seven added executable lines are covered; same-size claims preserve the output revision and subsequent deltas; changed dimensions still resize; same-size ownership transfer remains covered by the service regression.
review.uncovered_behavior: Existing native PTY failure and cleanup paths account for the uncovered lines in local.rs; screen.rs has complete line coverage.
review.limitations: Branch coverage is not instrumented. Three pre-existing ignored tests remain ignored. Linux and Windows platform-specific branches were not measured locally; Linux validation runs in PR CI.
review.follow_up: Review PR CI for Linux validation; no new uncovered executable lines.
